name: Jolpica F1
tagline: Ergast-compatible Formula 1 results and standings API for historical and current seasons.
description: Jolpica F1 is a community-maintained Formula 1 data API that preserves Ergast-compatible endpoints for race results, qualifying, lap times, pit stops, driver and constructor standings, and circuit information after Ergast’s service changes. It targets developers building F1 apps, analytics tools, and season trackers who need a drop-in or near-drop-in replacement for Ergast-style queries.

auth.details: No API key required for the public Ergast-compatible HTTP endpoints; requests are unauthenticated.

use_cases: get current season driver championship standings
fetch race results for a specific season and round
list constructors and driver standings after a race weekend
query qualifying results or lap times for a Grand Prix
look up circuit information and race schedule for a season
